title: 第一卷 第1章 因为公司给的太少
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋尔尔到恋综别墅门口的时候，直播已经开了。

工作人员站在摄像机后面，冲她比了个“请进”的手势。

宋尔尔低头看了一眼手机。

经纪人钱姐十分钟前还在给她发消息。

【顾南舟也在，你别闹。】

【公司给你这个机会不容易，你要懂事。】

宋尔尔盯着最后两个字看了两秒，回了一个字。

【哦。】

然后她把手机揣进兜里，拖着行李箱进了别墅。

弹幕在她露面的瞬间就炸了。

【她怎么来了？】

【宋尔尔？节目组疯了吧？】

【倒贴姐又来了，顾南舟快跑。】

【她不是前段时间刚被骂退网吗？】

【退什么退，黑红也是红。】

宋尔尔看不见弹幕，但她大概能猜到。

毕竟她现在的路人缘，属于狗路过都要摇头的程度。

别墅客厅里已经坐了几个人。

清纯小花林栀坐在沙发左侧，穿着白裙子，笑得很甜。

退役电竞选手周闻野靠在单人沙发上，看上去比她还不想上班。

新生代小演员姜眠坐得很端正，手指一直捏着裙边。

而顾南舟坐在最中间。

他看见宋尔尔进来，先是一愣，随即露出一个很熟练的笑。

那笑宋尔尔认识。

营业笑，三分深情，七分想上热搜。

主持人立刻迎上来：“欢迎尔尔来到《心动不设防》！先和大家打个招呼吧。”

宋尔尔把行李箱扶正，抬头看向镜头。

“大家好，我是宋尔尔。”

主持人等了两秒，见她没继续说，提醒道：“可以多说两句，比如为什么会来参加我们节目？”

客厅里安静了一瞬。

镜头很懂事地推近。

弹幕也很兴奋。

【来了来了，她肯定要说为了寻找真爱。】

【她敢当着顾南舟的面说吗？】

【别装了，不就是奔着顾南舟来的。】

宋尔尔沉默了一下。

然后她认真开口：“因为公司给得太少，但违约金太贵。”

主持人：“……”

嘉宾：“……”

直播间弹幕停了半秒，随后刷得比刚才还快。

【她说什么？】

【哈哈哈哈哈救命，谁家女明星这么实诚啊？】

【公司：你礼貌吗？】

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Song Er'er arrived at the door of Lianzong Villa, the live broadcast was already on.

The staff member stood behind the camera and gave her a "come in" gesture.

Song Er'er lowered his head and glanced at his phone.

Her agent, Sister Qian, was sending her a message ten minutes ago.

[Gu Nanzhou is here too, please stop making trouble.】

[It’s not easy for the company to give you this opportunity, you have to be sensible.】

Song Er'er stared at the last two words for two seconds and replied with one word.

【oh.】

Then she put her phone in her pocket and dragged her suitcase into the villa.

The barrage exploded the moment she appeared.

[Why is she here?】

【Songerer?Are the show crew crazy?】

[Sister Gu Tie is here again, Gu Nanzhou, run quickly.】

[Didn’t she just get scolded and quit the internet some time ago?】

[Why retreat? Black and red are also red.】

Song Er'er couldn't see the barrage, but she could probably guess it.

After all, her current popularity with passers-by is such that dogs would shake their heads when passing by.

Several people were already sitting in the living room of the villa.

The innocent little flower Lin Zhi is sitting on the left side of the sofa, wearing a white skirt and smiling sweetly.

Retired e-sports player Zhou Wenye was leaning on the single sofa, looking more reluctant to go to work than she did.

Jiang Mian, a young actor of the new generation, sat upright, holding the hem of her skirt with her fingers.

And Gu Nanzhou sat in the middle.

When he saw Song Er'er coming in, he was stunned for a moment, and then showed a very skillful smile.

Song Erer knows Naxiao.

Business smile, 30% affectionate, 70% want to be on the hot search.

The host immediately came up to us: "Welcome Er'er to "Heart Beats Without Defense"! Let's say hello to everyone first."

Song Erer straightened the suitcase and looked up at the camera.

"Hello everyone, my name is Song Er'er."

The host waited for two seconds and saw that she did not continue, so he reminded her: "You can say a few more words, such as why you came to participate in our show?"

The living room was quiet for a moment.

The camera zooms in very sensibly.

The barrage is also very exciting.

[Come, come, she must say that she is looking for true love.】

[Does she dare to say it in front of Gu Nanzhou?】

[Stop pretending, you are just here for Gu Nanzhou.】

Song Er was silent for a moment.

Then she spoke seriously: "Because the company gave me too little, but the liquidated damages were too expensive."

Host: "..."

Guest: "..."

The barrage in the live broadcast room paused for half a second, and then continued faster than before.

[What did she say?】

[Hahahahaha, help, who female celebrity is so honest?】

[Company: Are you polite?】
